name: contract-intake
description: Collect, through conversational Q&A (and questionnaire-style checklists when many fields are needed), the key transaction facts required before any contract drafting, review, negotiation or management work begins. Use this skill after scenario routing whenever the task sheet marks 交互采集=是. The per-scenario lists below are NON-EXHAUSTIVE reference baselines — the expert must analyze the user's specific request and scenario and ADAPTIVELY generate the questions that actually matter, expanding, cutting or reshaping the baseline rather than mechanically reciting it. The goal is to ask for exactly what is missing and decision-critical, never to fabricate deal facts.
